description: Foundation: add the dark/cream/gold colour tokens to tailwind.config.js, set the dark warm-gradient body background + CSS custom properties in src/index.css, and restyle the shared layout chrome (AppLayout wrapper, Sidebar, Navbar) and the shared TyreCard. This is the dependency for every other FEAT — all page className changes reference these tokens, so this MUST be done first and the tokens must exist before any page uses bg-brand-gold / bg-cream / border-gold-border etc.
steps: tailwind.config.js: extend theme.extend.colors — merge these into the existing colors object, PRESERVING every existing key (canvas, sidebar, brand.yellow/orange/dark, fleet, graphite, secondary, bordergray, softgrey, jk.*). Add brand.gold '#F7C928', brand.yellow '#FFD52A', brand.'warm-gold' '#D99B16', brand.'dark-gold' '#B8860B' (keep brand.orange + brand.dark); add dark: { primary:'#101114', sidebar:'#101010', surface:'#1C1D20', panel:'#17191D', card:'#292318' }; add cream: { DEFAULT:'#FFFDF5', 50:'#FFFDF5', 100:'#FFF5D9', 200:'#FFF3D5', 300:'#FFEDB8' }; add gold: { border:'#E9D9A5', light:'#E9E0CE', subtle:'#FFF0B8' }. Do not change content/plugins.

src/index.css: set body (and html) background to `linear-gradient(125deg, #101114 0%, #292318 45%, #72510D 100%)` and color to #E5E5E5; add a :root block of CSS custom properties for every token (--brand-gold, --brand-yellow, --brand-warm-gold, --brand-dark-gold, --dark-primary, --dark-sidebar, --dark-surface, --dark-panel, --dark-card, --cream, --cream-200, --gold-border, --gold-light, --gold-subtle); add a subtle fixed decorative overlay (faint radial golden glow and/or a very-low-opacity tyre-tread SVG) layered on the body so the gradient shows between cards. Keep ALL @tailwind directives, scrollbar rules, and the @keyframes animations (highwayDash, paverBeamGlow, engineRumble, nitroFlamePuff, smokePuffMove, headlightAura) untouched.

src/components/layout/AppLayout.tsx: change the root div `bg-[#F4F3EF] text-[#14161A]` to `bg-transparent text-slate-200` so the body dark gradient shows through; keep min-h-screen flex flex-col, the Navbar, the flex row, and `<main className="flex-1 p-6 md:p-8 overflow-y-auto w-full">`. Do NOT touch the FLEET_WORKSPACE_PATHS guard or the Navigate redirect logic.

src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx: aside `bg-[#14161A] border-r border-[#262A30]` -> `bg-[#101010] border-r border-white/5`. NavLink active: `bg-[#FFC800] text-black font-bold shadow-sm` -> `bg-brand-gold text-[#111111] font-bold shadow-sm`. NavLink inactive: `text-[#9AA0A6] font-medium hover:bg-[#20242B] hover:text-white` -> `text-[#E5E5E5] font-medium hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white`. Back button `text-[#9AA0A6] hover:bg-[#20242B]` -> `text-slate-400 hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white`. Active fleet card `bg-[#1E2228] border border-[#2D333B]` -> `bg-[#17191D] border border-gold-border`; label `text-[#FFC800]` -> `text-brand-gold`. Section label `text-[#5B6068]` -> `text-slate-500`. Bottom info card `bg-[#1A1D23] border border-[#262A30]` -> `bg-[#17191D] border border-gold-border`; `text-[#80868B]` -> `text-slate-400`. Keep all links/navigate/role logic.

src/components/layout/Navbar.tsx: header `bg-white border-b border-[#E2E0D8] shadow-sm` -> `bg-[#1C1D20] border-b border-gold-border/40`. Subtitle `text-[#5B6068]` -> `text-slate-400`. User name `text-slate-900` -> `text-white`. FLEET_MANAGER badge `bg-[#14161A] text-white ... border border-slate-700` -> `bg-brand-gold text-black rounded-full`. Fleet switcher link `text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800` -> `text-slate-300 hover:text-white`. Left divider `border-l border-slate-200` -> `border-l border-white/10`. Logout button `text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100` -> `text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10`. Keep logo img, dev-mode badge, all auth store usage.

src/components/tyre/TyreCard.tsx: card root — replace the conditional full coloured border (`border-2 ... border-emerald-400/orange-400/red-400`) with a uniform `bg-cream border border-gold-border rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col gap-3 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200` and keep a thin top accent strip `border-t-2 border-t-emerald-400 / border-t-[#E8770E] / border-t-red-400` based on status. Serial `text-slate-900` -> `text-[#344054]`; brand/model `text-slate-400` -> `text-slate-500`. Status badge block -> solid `bg-emerald-500 text-white` / `bg-amber-500 text-white` / `bg-red-500 text-white`. Lifecycle badge (getLifecycleBadgeClasses) -> NEW `bg-emerald-500 text-white`, REUSE `bg-blue-500 text-white`, RETREAD `bg-amber-500 text-white`, SCRAP `bg-red-500 text-white`. Tyre image container `bg-slate-50` -> `bg-cream-100`. View Link `bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white` -> `bg-brand-gold hover:bg-brand-warm-gold text-black`. Keep getTyreImage, getStatusDotColor, all props/links.

Navbar background is #1C1D20 with white user name and a golden Fleet Owner badge.
TyreCard uses bg-cream with border-gold-border and solid white-text status badges.
